scope: Fixed stronger ng-only setting; all lowercase neighbours, capitals before g, and listed punctuation pairs

measurement.name: sampled horizontal clearance
measurement.extra_samples: Common vertical-range endpoints; segment endpoints, t=0.5 and y extrema; midpoints between these event levels.
measurement.gap_definition: Minimum of second-ink leftmost x minus first-ink rightmost x at common sampled y, including boundary tangencies. Null if there is no common sampled ink.
measurement.overlap_method: Independent BooleanGlyph intersection of decomposed, positioned outlines (nonzero fill); absolute signed AreaPen contour sum. Boolean curve reconstruction is numerical.
measurement.warning_policy: Warn for overlap_area > 1 square font unit and/or sampled_gap < 32 font units. Area <= 1 is numerical tolerance; 32 is a design-review threshold, not a universal rule.
measurement.caveat: Sampled horizontal clearance, not exact Euclidean distance or a legibility verdict. A negative envelope gap alone does not establish actual ink overlap.

notes: Sampled horizontal envelope gaps are not exact Euclidean distances or optical judgments.
Warnings request visual review; they never authorize a spacing edit or fail an otherwise valid coverage build.
Word/space contexts are shaping-checked, not represented by this two-outline clearance metric.
Capital and punctuation diagnostics are not an expansion of approved kerning scope.
